text_block_list.text:
—Extreme weather. Entering August, the 
temperature kept rising, draining the 
stamina of the Umamusume.

Even so, among them were formidable 
Umamusume who didn't flinch in the 
slightest from the brutal heat.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, Grass-chan, it's wicked hot 
today! Let's go play in the water, play in 
the water♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Spe-chan, you're still full of 
energy even after training! Just the way I 
like it, yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, you two... If you've got so 
much energy to spare, you should just go 
run another lap."

One year above Narita Top Road. The 
strongest Umamusume, known as the "Golden 
Generation." And then—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Bwehh, it's so hot I'm meltinggg. How are 
you doing just fine, Opera O-san?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am fine. As an Overlord, I 
shall never melt and fall like the wings 
of Icarus.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to tire out over something 
like this. Not if I want to reach 'the 
horizon I'm aiming for.'"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"The horizon we aim for"... Does that mean 
autumn's "Kikka-sho"?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. But it doesn't stop there. Even 
after our youth has passed us by—”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Next year! So that I can win in the 
Senior Class too!

On the other hand, there were naturally 
some Umamusume looking quite worn out...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... How many times have I rewatched the 
Japan Derby footage now...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'll study tonight... Just one 
more time...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san...

While patrolling the training lodge, I 
spotted Narita Top Road working hard even 
during her free time.
choice_data_list:
Didn't I tell you recovery is important 
too?

I told you recovery is important too, 
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... That's right. I'm sorry...

I took her to the camp's main cafeteria... 
and handed her a special drink.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Is this... a homemade drink? It looks 
delicious. Thank you very much..."
choice_data_list:
It'll definitely work, so just drink it 
for now.

text_block_list.text:
I try to recover with an easily absorbed 
special drink... but this much still isn't 
enough.
choice_data_list:
Why don't you take a walk by the beach 
tonight?

text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of diversions you can 
only enjoy at the beach in summer. Like 
playing in the sand or lighting fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A walk... Playing in the sand, and 
fireworks, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I feel restless when I'm doing 
nothing, anyway.

Even if forced, she needed to take a 
breather. Narita Top Road didn't yet have 
the stamina to just laugh off the 
scorching heat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, up ahead... a light? Someone's on the 
beach... That's...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san! What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Camping on the sandy beach. This shore 
is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because the stars are so clear here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Ayabe-san. For tagging along 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Not particularly. Your presence doesn't 
bother me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Still, it's so hot every day, 
isn't it? It's hard to sleep at night, and 
my body just can't rest properly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What about you, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I feel the same. But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It makes no difference to me. Whether it's 
hard to sleep or impossible to rest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
As long as this body holds out until the 
Kikuka-sho. As long as it holds out until 
the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san... All the way to the goal...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I told you before, didn't I? I am not like 
you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This autumn, I will—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even if I fall, so be it. It's having that 
resolve that allows me to run the way I do 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe... -san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then... were you really thinking all along 
that it wouldn't matter if you burned out 
during your Classic year?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As long as I can dedicate a few 
Classic Triple Crown victories to her, 
that will be enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No way... But ruining your body just to 
win seems far too tragic...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine... Because this body is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"It was purely by chance that I was able 
to be born. Someday... I must return it."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even if aiming for the stars and grabbing 
hold ultimately leads to melting away...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can see it through... that's 
all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I only wish—to devote my life. ...To my 
star.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san... No way...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I know this might be meddling where I 
don't belong, but... even so, I just...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want you to take care of yourself too. 
Because...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san is an Umamusume I admire, after 
all. No, it's more than just that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because you are an irreplaceable friend. 
And I'm sure there are many others who 
feel the same way I do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
We're both... talking too much. Saying 
things we didn't need to say.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"It must be the summer. All that heat 
trapped in my body..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because of the fever... is it? In that 
case...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ayabe-san. Care to go for a short 
swim?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Swim...? ...In this outfit?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The sea at night looks so nice and 
cold. It's been so hot, my body's really 
feeling it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's cool down and refresh ourselves. 
That might help turn your mood around!
(SPLASH!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, feels so good—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know how much of my feelings 
reached them. Nor did they tell me 
everything. Even so...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I don't want Ayabe-san... to push herself 
too hard and collapse.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hey, feels nice, doesn't it, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "...Yes. And besides..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The stars are... beautiful. Even more so 
than looking at them from the dark sandy 
beach.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san! Since we're here, let's play 
some more! Not just swimming in the sea.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer told me to do so. To focus on 
recovering as much as possible. And that 
goes for you too, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we do something summer camp-y? 
It'll be fun if we do it together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't really mind, but... What are we 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, let's see. Trainer suggested playing 
in the sand or doing fireworks. So...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
How about reinforcing the tent's 
foundation? We're right by the sea, so it 
feels like it might get washed away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be better to pile on a little 
more sand?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Now that you mention it. All right, 
just a little bit, then...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Done!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Ayabe-san! Our castle is 
complete.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it... it's a sense of 
accomplishment! You had fun too, right, 
Ayabe-san?”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Fun...? I was...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just... go home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ayabe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Please leave me alone for a bit... Thank 
you, but I need some time to think.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Um, sorry for intruding.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't forget today. Let's both make this 
a wonderful summer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I must not. Any more than this... is 
not permitted...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm... sorry. Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm back.
choice_data_list: Were you able to relax a little?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It felt like some physical labor, but 
mentally, it felt great! Actually, down at 
the beach...

Afterward, I heard about her meeting with 
Admire Vega. It seemed she was able to 
spend a relaxing summer moment.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
How about taking our time with some 
sparklers? We can enjoy the thrill of 
watching the glowing ball about to drop.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sparklers... I suppose if it's just that 
much...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there! You can do it, Ayabe-san! 
You've got this. Just a little further!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, time's up! But impressive work! You 
lasted quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Indeed... It was a real nail-biter.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It was so much fun. You had fun too, 
didn't you, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Fun...? Did I... really...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just... go home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ayabe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Please leave me alone for a bit... Thank 
you, but I need some time to think.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Um, sorry for intruding.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't forget today. Let's both make this 
a wonderful summer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I must not. Any more than this... is 
not permitted...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm... sorry. Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm back.
choice_data_list: Were you able to relax a little?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We had a contest to see whose 
sparkler could last the longest. Actually, 
down at the beach...

Afterward, I heard about her meeting with 
Admire Vega. It seemed she was able to 
spend a relaxing summer moment.
